clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan sits the Sparklematic 5200, an automated cleaning contraption designed to scrub toxic filth from recovered salvaging. Operating the machine strips heavy grime from soiled objects and packages whatever is salvaged in a decorative gift box.

Gnomish engineering often prizes efficiency and whimsy in equal measure. The Sparklematic 5200 was built to handle toxic and contaminated refuse, scouring away grime and caustic residue through automated cycles. Once loaded and paid, the contraption rattles through its cleaning routine before emitting a cheerful ding, neatly wrapping whatever remains into a present tied with a bow.

Since the fall of Gnomeregan to the troggs and the subsequent radiation disaster, countless personal effects and technological scraps were smothered in industrial mire. Adventurers who feed grime-encrusted objects into the machine can reclaim lost gemstones, raw ores, and long-lost valuables that were swallowed up when the city was vented.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt. A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward. Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow. The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status. Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.
Well, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...
